title: Connectivity
description: How this device and a Host reach each other: the local server, the relay and tunnel, pairing, remote hosts, push, and sync.

overview.label: Overview
overview.description: What this shell is, what it is linked to, and how.

local-host.label: Local host
local-host.description: The companion server, its binding, TLS, discovery, and browser access.

cloud-relay.label: Cloud & relay
cloud-relay.description: The relay, peer-to-peer upgrade, tunnel, sign-in, and collaboration server.

pairing.label: Pairing
pairing.description: Invitations, browser enrollment, and the devices that redeemed them.

remote-hosts.label: Remote hosts
remote-hosts.description: The Hosts this device drives, and adding one.

push.label: Push
push.description: APNs and FCM credentials, and a test notification.

sync.label: Sync
sync.description: Per-table mirror state between this device and its Host.

reach.no-host: This browser is not connected to a Host, so there is nothing to configure here.
reach.needs-desktop-shell: This control needs the desktop app itself. The connected Host is headless, and a tunnel process or an mDNS socket only exists on a desktop.
reach.not-owner: Only the Host's owner device may change how the Host is reachable.

reachNext.no-host: Pair with a Host from the Remote hosts topic, or open the desktop app.
reachNext.needs-desktop-shell: Use the desktop app on the Host machine, or expose it with the relay instead.
reachNext.not-owner: Ask the owner to grant this device host administration, or use the owner device.

overview.runtimeDescription: Where work runs from here, and over which link.
overview.tierNotApplicable: Not applicable: this shell runs work locally.
overview.tierPending: Not reported yet: the link to this host is still being negotiated.
overview.eventPlaneDescription: Whether events reach the other side, beyond request and reply.
overview.devicePlanes: {count, plural, =0 {No paired devices.} =1 {One paired device.} other {# paired devices.}}
overview.degradedHint: Requests still answer, but no events are arriving. Changes made elsewhere will not appear until the event stream reconnects.

pairing.reachRelayHint: This invitation carries a relay room: the device may redeem it from any network, and the direct address is tried first.
pairing.reachDirectHint: This invitation has no relay room: the device must reach the address above directly. Turn the relay on under Cloud & relay to pair from anywhere.

remoteHosts.registryDescription: Hosts this device can drive. One is active at a time.
remoteHosts.empty: No hosts are registered yet. Add one below with an invitation from the Host.
remoteHosts.addDescription: Paste an invitation from the Host's Pairing topic. The relay is used when the Host cannot be reached directly.
remoteHosts.addDescriptionScan: Paste or scan an invitation from the Host's Pairing topic. The relay is used when the Host cannot be reached directly.

push.testDescription: Sends a metadata-only push through the configured providers to every paired device whose socket is closed right now.
push.testSent: {count, plural, =0 {Sent to no devices: every paired device is online or has no push token.} =1 {Sent to one offline device.} other {Sent to # offline devices.}}
push.testNeedsCredentials: Configure APNs or FCM above first.
push.testResult: {count, plural, =0 {Last test reached no devices.} =1 {Last test reached one device.} other {Last test reached # devices.}}

remoteAccess.title: Reach from outside
remoteAccess.description: Whether a device away from this network can reach this Host right now, and by which route.

verdict.anywhereLegacy: Reachable from anywhere, over a rendezvous that cannot carry app traffic
verdict.meshOnly: Reachable from devices on the same overlay network
verdict.notHost: This shell is not a Host, so there is nothing to reach.

routeState.relayLegacy: Relay reachable, but it predates the data lane
routeState.relayNotRelay: The address answers, but it is not a Cognia rendezvous
routeState.relayInvalid: The signaling URL is not valid
routeState.relayCorsBlocked: Relay answered, but this browser may not read it

relayCheck.title: Rendezvous check
relayCheck.description: Asks the relay this Host dials what it can carry. The answer is what a device on another network will get.
relayCheck.off: The relay is switched off in the WebRTC card below, so nothing away from this network can pair or connect through it.
relayCheck.sourceLocal: Reading this browser's own relay setting: nothing is paired, so this is what a Host started from here would dial.
relayCheck.ready: Reachable in {ms} ms. Protocol {protocol}, {backend} backend, version {version}.
relayCheck.legacy: Reachable in {ms} ms, but this rendezvous predates the application data lane (ADR-0170). Pairing and signaling work. Application traffic falls back to the peer-to-peer channel only, so a device behind a strict NAT will not connect. Deploy the current signaling server.
relayCheck.legacyProtocol: Reachable in {ms} ms, but its protocol is {theirs} and this app speaks {ours}. Update the one that is behind.
relayCheck.unreachable: No answer from {url}: {error}. A device on another network will not be able to pair or connect through the relay until the rendezvous answers.
relayCheck.notRelay: {url} answered, but not as a Cognia rendezvous ({error}). Check the signaling URL below.
relayCheck.invalidUrl: The signaling URL below is not a valid ws:// or wss:// address.
relayCheck.corsBlocked: {url} answered, but this browser origin was not allowed to read the answer. The deployed rendezvous predates the readable health endpoint and the application data lane (ADR-0170): pairing and signaling work, application traffic falls back to the peer-to-peer channel only. Deploy the current signaling server, or run this check from the desktop app.
relayCheck.notFromHost: This check ran from this device, not from the Host. It proves this device reaches the rendezvous; the Host's own route out is still unproven, so the summary above does not count it.

statusPage.title: Public status page
statusPage.description: Live availability, incidents and maintenance for the official hosted relay, measured by Cognia's own probes. Opening it does not check your relay.
statusPage.official: This device uses the official hosted relay, so the status page describes it. The check above is still the proof for this device's own connection.
statusPage.selfHosted: This device uses a different relay ({host}). The public status page describes only the official hosted relay, not this one: its status says nothing about your relay. Use the check above instead.
statusPage.openFailed: The status page could not be opened. Visit {url} in a browser.

mesh.title: Overlay network
mesh.description: Tailscale or ZeroTier put this Host and a phone anywhere on one private network, so the plain local route works from the road with nothing exposed to the internet.
mesh.advertiseDescription: Invitations and the local-route report name {address} instead of the auto-detected LAN address. Requires the companion server to be bound to the LAN.
mesh.advertiseCleared: Invitations advertise the auto-detected LAN address again.
mesh.advertiseStale: Invitations advertise {address}, but no interface carries it right now. Start the overlay client, or stop advertising it.
mesh.loopbackHint: The companion server is bound to this machine only. Switch it to LAN under Local host before advertising an overlay address.
mesh.installHint: Install a client on this machine and on the device, sign both into the same network, then come back: the address appears here.
mesh.advertiseDescriptionSaved: Invitations and the local-route report name {address} instead of the auto-detected LAN address. No interface carries it right now, so switch this off to go back to detection.

tunnelInstall.title: Install {tool}
tunnelInstall.description: Run one of these on this machine, then check again.
tunnelInstall.descriptionOs: Run one of these on this {os} machine, then check again.

tunnel.busyTitle: The tunnel is exposing something else
tunnel.busyBody: This app runs one cloudflared process. It is exposing {localUrl} at {publicUrl} for another feature. Replacing it changes what that public URL points at.
tunnel.exposingOther: This tunnel currently exposes {localUrl}, not this listener. Turn it off and on again here to point it at the companion server, or leave it for the feature using it.
tunnel.busyStopBody: This app runs one cloudflared process, and it is exposing {localUrl} at {publicUrl} for another feature. Stopping it here takes that public URL down too.

githubRunner.title: GitHub runner development environments
githubRunner.description: Create a temporary Linux host, then use Cognia’s existing remote workspace and Agent tools.
githubRunner.desktopRequired: Create and manage runners from the desktop app.
githubRunner.prerequisites: Install .github/workflows/cognia-runner.yml in your repository first. Sign in with gh on this device. Use immutable image digests and a reachable signaling server. GitHub queue time varies.
githubRunner.loadFailed: Could not load runner leases. Refresh to retry.
githubRunner.operationFailed: The runner operation failed. Refresh its status and inspect the GitHub run before retrying.
githubRunner.invalid: Check these fields: {fields}. Images must include a sha256 digest.
githubRunner.stopPending: Cancellation requested. The runner is not confirmed stopped; refresh until GitHub reports completion.
githubRunner.leaseError: The runner reported an error. Inspect its GitHub run and refresh before retrying.
githubRunner.persistence: Copy or commit workspace changes and export artifacts before stopping. Runner storage disappears when the job ends. Connecting switches this desktop’s active execution host.
githubRunner.pairingInactive: Runner pairing is no longer active.
githubRunner.runnerNotReady: The runner is no longer ready.
githubRunner.guideOpenFailed: Could not open the setup guide. Try again.
githubRunner.savedConfiguration: The last valid configuration you submit is saved on this desktop and restored next time. Use only public, credential-free signaling URLs.

wizard.intro: Check your repository, configure the environment, then review before creating.

setup.title: Repository
setup.description: Choose the repository and branch containing the runner template.

environment.title: Environment
environment.description: Choose a name, lifetime, three published images and your signaling relay.

review.title: Review
review.description: Confirm the configuration before submitting a GitHub Actions workflow.

wizard.setupHelp: Install GitHub CLI and run gh auth login on this computer. Copy all five template files into your repository and configure COGNIA_RUNNER_ACTORS as described in the setup guide.
wizard.checkingHint: Checking GitHub may take a moment. The check stops after 90 seconds and does not submit a workflow.
wizard.checkFailed: Could not complete the checks. Check GitHub connectivity and your gh login, then try again.
wizard.reviewHint: These checks do not verify COGNIA_RUNNER_ACTORS, organization policies, image availability or relay connectivity. Confirm those using the setup guide.
wizard.restored: Your last submitted configuration has been restored. Check it before creating another environment.
wizard.imagesHint: Build and publish all three Linux amd64 images first, then paste their immutable digests. This wizard does not build or publish images.
wizard.createdHint: Follow the environment status below. When it is ready, select Connect to pair with the Host. Recording the request does not mean the Host is ready.

hints.label: A name for this environment in Cognia; defaults to the repository name.
hints.repository: Enter owner/repo or paste its https://github.com/owner/repo URL. Use a repository where you can run Actions.
hints.workflowRef: The branch containing the five matching template files, for example main. Use a branch, not a tag.
hints.hostImage: Published Cognia Host image. Use runtime-full if you need preinstalled Agent CLIs on the Host.
hints.agentBundleImage: Published Agent bundle image containing the pinned Agent runtimes and sandbox helper.
hints.developmentImage: Published development image with your project tools and a libc compatible with the Agent bundle.
hints.signalingUrl: Reachable Cognia signaling relay using wss://. Do not include credentials, query parameters or a fragment.
hints.lifetimeMinutes: Choose 60, 120 or 240 minutes, or enter a whole number from 10 to 330. Export your work before the lease ends.

validation.label: Enter a name without control characters, up to 120 UTF-8 bytes.
validation.repository: Enter owner/repo or a GitHub repository URL without subpages, credentials, query parameters or a fragment.
validation.workflowRef: Enter a branch name up to 200 characters using letters, numbers, dots, slashes, underscores or hyphens; do not use two consecutive dots.
validation.hostImage: Enter an image reference ending in @sha256: and exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits.
validation.agentBundleImage: Enter an image reference ending in @sha256: and exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits.
validation.developmentImage: Enter an image reference ending in @sha256: and exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits.
validation.signalingUrl: Enter a wss:// URL without credentials, query parameters or a fragment.
validation.lifetimeMinutes: Enter a whole number from 10 to 330 minutes.

codes.not_checked: Resolve the earlier failed check, then try again.
codes.invalid_repository: Enter a valid owner/repo or GitHub repository URL.
codes.invalid_ref: Enter a valid branch name, then check again.
codes.cli_unavailable: GitHub CLI could not run. Install gh or fix its local installation, then try again.
codes.account_unavailable: Could not verify your GitHub account. Check connectivity and run gh auth status; use gh auth login if needed.
codes.repository_unavailable: Could not read this repository. Check its name, your account access and GitHub connectivity.
codes.repository_not_writable: This account needs write access to the provisioner repository. Use an authorized account or repository.
codes.repository_inactive: This repository is archived or disabled. Use an active repository.
codes.branch_unavailable: Could not resolve this branch. Check that it exists in the selected repository and retry.
codes.workflow_unavailable: Could not read the runner workflow. Install the template on the default branch, enable Actions and check repository access.
codes.workflow_inactive: The runner workflow is disabled. Enable it in GitHub Actions, then check again.
codes.templates_unavailable: Could not read a required template file. Copy all five files to this branch and check repository access. File:
codes.templates_mismatch: A template file differs from this Cognia version. Replace all five files from the matching setup guide and commit them. File:
codes.timeout: The checks timed out. Check GitHub connectivity and try again.

stateHelp.dispatching: The request is being submitted or its outcome is being recovered. Refresh before creating another runner.
stateHelp.queued: GitHub is waiting for an available runner. Queue time varies; you can inspect the Actions run.
stateHelp.starting: The runner is pulling images and preparing the Host. Inspect the Actions run for progress.
stateHelp.ready: Select Connect to verify and pair with this temporary Host.
stateHelp.stopping: Waiting for GitHub to confirm the workflow has ended.
stateHelp.stopped: This runner has ended. Create a new environment to continue working.
stateHelp.failed: Inspect the GitHub run, resolve the failure and refresh before creating another environment.
stateHelp.unknown: The current status could not be confirmed. Refresh and inspect the GitHub run before retrying.
